title: Analysis by family: what each family's decisions need, read on the training rows only
request: Extend the analysis per family on training rows only: without labels the shape of normal, rule hits, per-entity behaviour and a planted-anomaly check of what detectors can find; partial labels; time; entities; places; each finding naming the decision it bears on. Each family's replica must yield the findings its decisions need, and none may read a holdout row.
spec: New arguments to analyse and one function per family, each on the training rows; a checked vocabulary of decisions mapped to the ledger; a poison guard over every replica.
plan: Survey what analyse finds on each replica today.
Add the no-label block and the per-family findings, each on the training rows.
Check every decision a finding names against a vocabulary mapped to the ledger.
Poison every held-out row and require every training-rows finding unchanged.

decisions.decision: The finding contract stays; the decision a finding bears on is its existing affects list, now checked.
decisions.why: A new field would move the frozen schema for what the contract already holds.

decisions.decision: The planted shapes are generic (a value beyond the range, a broken pair), never the replica's frauds.
decisions.why: The check says what a detector can see on these columns; planting the known frauds would measure the answer key.

decisions.decision: Which rows the label file marks is read on the training rows only; label rows matching no row at all are counted apart as structure.
decisions.why: Membership of a held-out row among the cases is a fact about its target.

decisions.decision: Findings about structure (duplicates, keys, unmatched labels) keep reading all rows.
decisions.why: A duplicate or a key across the split is the problem itself; the guard covers every finding about the training rows.

change: dclab_core/analyse.py (dclab-core 0.22.0); tests/test_core_analyse_families.py (new), test_core_analyse.py; CHANGELOG, the plan, the roadmap.

findings.defect: An identifier was flagged as counted during follow-up.
findings.scenario: subscriber_id grows with the signup date and moved with the duration.
findings.cause: Every column was checked against the duration.
findings.fix: Identifiers are excluded from the follow-up check.

findings.defect: The detector check missed half of the planted far values.
findings.scenario: Values beyond every column's range were found 47% of the time.
findings.cause: The forest's 256-row sub-samples rarely held a planted row, and identical planted values masked each other.
findings.fix: Sub-samples of up to 1024 rows and a distance of its own for each planted value.

findings.defect: A negatively correlated pair was never broken.
findings.scenario: For b = -a, the planted rows followed the pair's normal pattern and the check reported broken pairs missed.
findings.cause: The pair's correlation was taken in absolute value, so its sign was lost.
findings.fix: The pair is chosen by its absolute correlation and broken against its sign.

findings.defect: On skewed columns the far value was not far.
findings.scenario: On lognormal columns no planted row was found, because real rows sat beyond eight deviations.
findings.cause: Values were planted at eight robust deviations, inside a heavy tail.
findings.fix: Beyond the column's range, skewed columns on a log scale; the implication no longer claims the data's anomalies will be missed.

findings.defect: Recall could not reach one on small tables.
findings.scenario: At 200 rows, ten planted rows were sought among the top two.
findings.cause: The budget was 1% of the rows while at least ten were planted.
findings.fix: Recall among as many top rows as were planted.

findings.scenario: An intermittent series, flagged rows with no entity, and a text outcome produced non-finite evidence.
findings.cause: Correlations and shares over empty or constant data.
findings.fix: Non-finite values dropped, empty shares skipped, text outcomes not averaged.

findings.defect: Forty arms crashed the arms finding.
findings.scenario: A treatment column with forty values exceeded the evidence's mapping limit.
findings.fix: The ten largest arms and the share of the rest.

findings.defect: A text or gappy event flag crashed the censoring finding.
findings.scenario: An event of ended or active, or one with missing values, raised.
findings.cause: The flag was cast to numbers without checking.
findings.fix: A flag that is not 0/1 is said; missing rows are dropped first.

findings.defect: An unreadable event flag was reported as fine.
findings.scenario: Every row ended: the finding said none were censored and recommended Cox.
findings.cause: The censoring check's refusal was only in the evidence.
findings.fix: The refusal is the statement, as a warning.

findings.defect: The label join counted held-out cases as not in the table.
findings.scenario: With a time split, most recent cases fall in the holdout and were called missing.
findings.cause: The join was moved to the training rows but its wording was not.
findings.fix: Found among the training rows; label rows matching no row at all counted apart as structure.

findings.defect: An epoch-seconds time column was read as nanoseconds.
findings.scenario: Every row fell on one day, so rows per entity and day were rows per entity.
findings.fix: A numeric time column is not read as dates; a span under a day says nothing per day.

measurements.name: what a detector finds on the fraud replica's rides
measurements.gate: descriptive: a planted-anomaly check, no gate
measurements.result: 98% of 124 planted far values and 9% of 124 planted broken pairs among the top 124
limits: Generic shapes, not the replica's frauds.

outcome: Eight families' replicas yield the findings their decisions need, each naming a decision the ledger knows, and no finding about the training rows reads a held-out row.
lessons: A planted-anomaly check measures the detector's settings as much as the data: a forest's default sub-sample hides a 1% shape.
Identical planted values mask each other; give each its own.
When a computation moves to the training rows, its wording must move with it.
risks: The studio does not pass the family yet.
Four families add no findings of their own.
